headline: This law directs the Interior Department to transfer federal electric distribution fixtures, pole-use licenses, and access rights in Utah Valley to a local electric service district.
what_it_does: It requires the Secretary of the Interior to convey federal interests in an electric distribution system and related lands to the South Utah Valley Electric Service District, once the Strawberry Water Users Association has transferred its own interest in that system. The District takes on all liability for running, maintaining, and replacing the system, and the United States is no longer liable for damages tied to it. Before the transfer, the Interior Department must comply with environmental and endangered species laws, and the transferred land can no longer count as part of a federal reclamation project. The law keeps federal ownership of power generation facilities and certain 46-kilovolt transmission lines, and it requires a report to Congress if the transfer is not finished within one year.

who_it_affects.group: South Utah Valley Electric Service District
who_it_affects.how: It receives federal fixtures, pole-use licenses, and access rights, and it becomes responsible for operating, maintaining, and replacing the electric distribution system.
Its transfer of its interest in the electric distribution system to the District is the condition that triggers the federal conveyance.

who_it_affects.group: Bureau of Reclamation and Department of the Interior
who_it_affects.how: The Secretary must carry out the conveyance, complete environmental and endangered species reviews, and report to Congress if the transfer stalls.

who_it_affects.group: Customers served by the electric distribution system in the Utah Valley area
who_it_affects.how: The local District, rather than the federal government, becomes the entity responsible for the system that delivers their electricity.

when_it_takes_effect: Upon enactment on July 18, 2013, with the conveyance to follow once the required conditions are met; a report to Congress is due if it is not completed within one year.
